profile.headline: Senior Software Engineer, Senior Consultant, Team Leadership

positions.title: Technical Lead
positions.description:
- Managed 15+ cross-functional teams to deliver accessible enterprise web solutions on platforms such as HCL Web Content Manager for world-class companies and Government Agencies.
- Led the end-to-end project lifecycle, including requirement gathering, technical design, scrum planning, and architectural and code reviews.
- Mentored and coached web developers to grow in responsibility and develop their skills.
- Delivered training sessions for clients' needs as well as for onboarding processes to ensure knowledge transfer.
- Developed templates for generating pages using reusable components with HCL WCM Site Builder automated tool.
- Developed a Design System with optimized and accessible components that increased the speed of page creation. 
- Developed a data portal platform for offering access to various data sets from different sources allowing users to search, download and visualize data for specific research.
- Developed and maintained RESTful APIs, facilitating seamless integration of internal and third-party applications such as form.io, ESRI Maps, Google Maps, and other proprietary APIs.
- Client Project for the State of Ohio and over 25 government agencies integration to the Innovate Ohio Platform to improve and unify the global experience of creating dynamic content and navigation through the sites.

positions.title: Frontend Developer
positions.description:
- Created and implemented accessible interactive prototypes for web apps through HCL WCM WebSphere Portal 8.0 and Liferay technologies.
- Client Projects: PepsiCo Global Intranet and several PepsiCo internal projects, Wisconsin Physicians Services GHA Claim Denials Database development, CEMEX Mexico Liferay Migration.

positions.title: SAP ABAP Developer
positions.description:
- Led and developed SAP Banking Solutions.
- Created business objects through BAPIS and ABAP programming
- Designed and developed ALV reports, smart forms, programs, and functions.
- Produced entity relationship diagrams and tables, and designed flow approvals workflows
